checks.name: inclusive_and_open_end
checks.code:
from ranges import serve_range
assert serve_range(b'abcdef','bytes=1-3') == (206,b'bcd','bytes 1-3/6')
assert serve_range(b'abcdef','bytes=3-') == (206,b'def','bytes 3-5/6')

checks.name: suffix_and_clamp
checks.code:
from ranges import serve_range
assert serve_range(b'abcdef','bytes=-2') == (206,b'ef','bytes 4-5/6')
assert serve_range(b'abcdef','bytes=4-99') == (206,b'ef','bytes 4-5/6')

checks.name: unsatisfiable_and_invalid
checks.code:
from ranges import serve_range
assert serve_range(b'abc','bytes=9-') == (416,b'','bytes */3')
for h in ['bytes=1-2,3-4','bytes=-','bytes=2-1']:
 try:
  result=serve_range(b'abc',h)
  assert result[0] == 416
 except ValueError: pass
